summary: PulseGuard v0.6.11 fixes a Full Health Scan crash that could occur when a Windows event category returned exactly one matching event.

sections.heading: Full Health Scan reliability
sections.detail: Windows hardware and stability event sources are now normalized before being combined, preventing a single EventLogRecord from aborting the scan.

sections.heading: Event evidence preserved
sections.detail: The fix changes only how event collections are combined; existing historical-event watermarks, scoring, repair verification, and Event Viewer evidence remain unchanged.

sections.heading: General maintenance
sections.detail: No driver, Hardware Health, optimizer workflow, updater, or report behavior was changed in this hotfix.
